data.title: A window flag that changes nothing is an error, not a no-op
data.why: report velocity and report workload have no window, so --since on them can only mean the caller believes something that is not true. Silently ignoring it would hand back a number the caller thinks is scoped and is not - the exact failure every report here names its window to avoid. Same for --sprint on anything but burndown.
data.rejected: Accepting the flag everywhere and ignoring it where it does not apply, which is what most CLIs do
